title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 109
description: Ten questions on Psalms 109: a prayer against lying accusers, curses on the wicked man who loved cursing, and a plea of the poor and needy for help.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask the God of his praise not to do?
questions.explanation: Psalms 109:1 says: God of my praise, don't remain silent.

questions.text: What does the psalmist do while his enemies are his adversaries in return for his love?
questions.explanation: Psalms 109:4 says: in return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

questions.text: They have rewarded the psalmist evil for what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 109:5 says they have rewarded him evil for good, and hatred for his love.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask another man to take from the wicked man?
questions.explanation: Psalms 109:8 says: let his days be few; let another take his office.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask for the wicked man's wife?
questions.explanation: Psalms 109:9 says: let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

answers.text: That she return to her father

questions.text: What did the wicked man love?
questions.explanation: Psalms 109:17 says he loved cursing, and it came to him; he didn't delight in blessing.

questions.text: Cursing came into his inward parts like water, and like what into his bones?
questions.explanation: Psalms 109:18 says it came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

questions.text: The psalmist fades away like an evening shadow and is shaken off like what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 109:23 says: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

questions.text: Why are the psalmist's knees weak?
questions.explanation: Psalms 109:24 says his knees are weak through fasting, and his body is thin and lacks fat.

questions.text: At whose right hand will Yahweh stand, according to the last verse?
questions.explanation: Psalms 109:31 says he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
